definitions.explanation: So great that it cannot be measured or estimated: used of damage, influence, value, effort or potential.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{計|はか}り{知|し}れない。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{計|はか}り{知|し}れない。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{計|はか}り{知|し}れない。
examples.english: The influence this invention has had on society is immeasurable.

notes:
The potential form of ⟦{計|はか}る→計る：28292_hakaru⟧ (to measure) + ⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧, negated: "cannot be measured and known." Written; in speech people more often say ものすごい or ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧. Also written {測|はか}り{知|し}れない.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計|はか}り{知|し}れない⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: immeasurable influence
- {計|はか}り{知|し}れない⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧: incalculable losses
- {計|はか}り{知|し}れない⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧: limitless potential
- {計|はか}り{知|し}れない⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧: inestimable value

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{莫大|ばくだい}→莫大：03700_bakudai⟧な: enormous; of an amount that can in principle be counted (money, cost)
